frozen_statement: Primary temporal/inferential dataset contains 2,703 spectra after QC and exclusion of Evaluation 5, Block 7.
evidence_note: E5-B7 showed a block-wide SWIR anomaly and materially affected E5 results; exact duplicates and low-signal spectra remain excluded from the primary set.

frozen_statement: FOC R1-only first shows a statistically supported regional spectral difference at Evaluation 4 in VIS 400–700 nm.
evidence_note: Mean ΔR = +0.00441 (~+9.9% vs control); exact block sign-flip p=0.0078; Holm p=0.0391 across five predefined regions.

frozen_statement: The E4 FOC R1 VIS result is robust to all six tested QC scenarios.
evidence_note: Mean ΔR remains 0.004411–0.004466 and Holm p=0.0391 in all QC scenarios.

frozen_statement: No individual wavelength survives family-wise maxT correction across all 2,151 bands.
decision: Use to avoid claiming a single diagnostic wavelength.
evidence_note: Supports interpretation as a broad regional response rather than a single-band biomarker.

frozen_statement: No evaluation/group comparison reaches p<0.05 in block-constrained global multivariate permutation testing.
decision: Use as a constraint on interpretation.
evidence_note: Prevents overstatement of broad whole-spectrum separation.

frozen_statement: The E4 FOC VIS effect is concentrated mainly in leaf 6 rather than leaf 2.
evidence_note: H6-Media +0.00949, H6-Nervadura +0.00803, H6-Margen +0.00547; leaf-2 configurations ~+0.0009 to +0.0012.

frozen_statement: No single leaf-position configuration can be declared statistically superior after correction across 30 configuration×region tests.
evidence_note: No combination survived the full Holm family at p<0.05.

frozen_statement: For FOC R1, the most defensible candidate feature region is broad visible-to-red-edge, approximately 520–749 nm, especially at E4/leaf 6.
decision: Use as exploratory feature-region result, not mechanistic proof.
evidence_note: Raw stable windows cluster in 520–654 and ~690–709 nm; derivative candidates occur around 650–749 nm.

frozen_statement: For FOC, the 520–749 nm window performs approximately as well as the full 350–2500 nm spectrum on average across matched ML scenarios.
evidence_note: Mean balanced-accuracy difference window minus full spectrum = -0.0035 across 108 matched scenarios.

frozen_statement: Whole-plant E4 classification using 520–749 nm and RBF-SVM reaches balanced accuracy 0.703 and is stable to QC choices.
evidence_note: Sensitivity 0.531; specificity 0.875; AUC 0.629; BA unchanged across six QC scenarios.

frozen_statement: E1 H6-Margen full-spectrum PLS-DA reaches balanced accuracy 0.859, but this is model-dependent.
decision: Do not use as evidence that detection is established at E1.
evidence_note: Median BA across 9 pipelines for E1 H6-Margen is 0.656 despite the isolated maximum; no inferential E1 regional signal.

frozen_statement: Whole-plant E5 full-spectrum logistic regression reaches primary BA 0.799 but is moderately QC-sensitive.
decision: Do not make it a central conclusion.
evidence_note: BA varies 0.732–0.804 across QC scenarios; reintroducing E5-B7 lowers BA to 0.760.

frozen_statement: No robust inferential regional separation was established for Radopholus-only across E1–E6.
evidence_note: ML estimates are unstable because each block contains only one Radopholus-only plant and one control plant.

frozen_statement: Coinoculation does not show confirmatory regional or global multivariate separation after correction.
evidence_note: Some predictive configurations are moderate, but inferential support is absent.
